questions.question: Find the value of \(\frac{\tan 55^\circ}{\cot 35^\circ}\)
questions.questionHtml: Find the value of \(\frac{\tan 55^\circ}{\cot 35^\circ}\)
questions.solution:
We can rewrite the expression as:

\( \frac{\tan 55^\circ}{\cot 35^\circ} = \frac{\tan 55^\circ}{\frac{1}{\tan 35^\circ}} = \tan 55^\circ \times \tan 35^\circ \)

Using the identity \( \tan(90^\circ - \theta) = \cot \theta \), we know that:

\( \tan 55^\circ = \cot 35^\circ \)

Therefore:

\( \tan 55^\circ \times \tan 35^\circ = 1 \)

The value of \( \frac{\tan 55^\circ}{\cot 35^\circ} \) is 1.

questions.question: If cos θ = \(\frac{5}{13}\) , what is the value of cot θ ?
questions.questionHtml: If cos θ = \(\frac{5}{13}\) , what is the value of cot θ ?
questions.solution:
cos θ = \(\frac{5}{13}\) , ⇒ \(cos^2\theta=\frac{25}{169}\)

⇒ \(sin^2\theta=1-cos^2\theta=1-\frac{25}{169}=\frac{169-25}{169}=\frac{144}{169}\) ⇒ sin θ= \(\sqrt{\frac{144}{169}}=\frac{12}{13}\)

The value of cot θ = \(\frac{cos θ}{sinθ}=\frac{\frac{5}{13}}{\frac{12}{13}}=\frac{5}{12}\)

questions.question: Find the value of cot 25°cot 35°cot 45°cot 55°cot 65°.
questions.questionHtml: Find the value of cot 25°cot 35°cot 45°cot 55°cot 65°.
questions.solution:
Given:

cot 25°cot 35°cot45°cot 55°cot 65°

Formulas used:

cot (90°- A). cot A = 1

tan (90°- A). tan A = 1

Calculation:

cot 25°cot 35°cot45°cot 55°cot 65°

⇒ cot 25° × cot 35° × cot45° × cot (90° - 35°) × cot (90° - 25°)    [ tan 45° = 1]

⇒ 1 × 1× 1 = 1 

∴ The required result is 1

Shortcut Trick

We can also look for pairs of angles which can give us sum equivalent to 90° and cancel them out directly.

⇒ 25° + 65° = 90° 

And 35° + 55° = 90° 

cot 45° will be equal to 1.

By doing so we will get 1 as our answer.

questions.question: Find the value of \(\frac{sec 35^{\circ}}{cosec 55^{\circ}} - \frac{cos 25^{\circ}}{sin 65^{\circ}}\)

Find the value of
\(\frac{sec 35^{\circ}}{cosec 55^{\circ}} - \frac{cos 25^{\circ}}{sin 65^{\circ}}\)
questions.solution:
Formula Used:

sec θ = 1 / cos θ, csc θ = 1 / sin θ

Calculation:

sec 35° / csc 55° = (1 / cos 35°) / (1 / sin 55°) = sin 55° / cos 35°

Since sin 55° = cos 35°, sin 55° / cos 35° = 1

Similarly, since sin 65° = cos 25°, cos 25° / sin 65° = cos 25° / cos 25° = 1

(1 - 1) = 0

questions.question: If sin(20 + x)° = cos 60°, 0 ≤ (20 + x) ≤ 90, then find the value of 2sin 2 (3x + 15)° - cosec 2 (2x + 10)°.

questions.solution:
Given:

sin(20 + x)° = cos 60°

Concept used:

Cos(90 - θ) = sinθ

Calculaton:

sin(20 + x)° = cos 60°

⇒ sin(20 + x)° = cos(90 - 30)°

⇒ sin(20 + x)° = sin30°

⇒ (20 + x)° = 30°

⇒ x° = 30 - 20 = 10°

So,

2sin2(3x + 15)° - cosec2(2x + 10)° = 2sin2(30 + 15)° - cosec2(20 + 10)°

⇒ 2sin245° - cosec230°

⇒ 2 × 1/2 - 4

⇒ 1 - 4

⇒ - 3

∴ Required answer is - 3

questions.question: The value of the expression \(\rm \frac{4\sin^230^{\circ}+\cos^260^{\circ}-\tan^245^{\circ}}{2\sin60^{\circ}\cos30^{\circ}-\tan45^{\circ}}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of the expression \(\rm \frac{4\sin^230^{\circ}+\cos^260^{\circ}-\tan^245^{\circ}}{2\sin60^{\circ}\cos30^{\circ}-\tan45^{\circ}}\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\rm \frac{4\sin^230^{\circ}+\cos^260^{\circ}-\tan^245^{\circ}}{2\sin60^{\circ}\cos30^{\circ}-\tan45^{\circ}}\)

Concept Used:

The values of all the trigonometric functions are based on the value of the ratio of sides in a right-angled triangle

Calculations:

⇒ sin 30º= \(\frac{1}{2}\)

⇒ cos60º= \(\frac{1}{2}\)

⇒ tan 45º= 1

⇒ sin 60º= \(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\)

⇒ cos 30º= \(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\)

According to the question,

⇒ \(\rm \frac{4\sin^230^{\circ}+\cos^260^{\circ}-\tan^245^{\circ}}{2\sin60^{\circ}\cos30^{\circ}-\tan45^{\circ}}=\frac{4\times(\frac{1}{2})^2+(\frac{1}{2})^2-(1)^2}{2\times \frac{\sqrt3}{2}\times\frac{\sqrt3}{2}-1}=\frac{4\times\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{4}-1}{2\times\frac{3}{4}-1}=\frac{1+\frac{1}{4}-1}{\frac{3}{2}-1}=\frac{\frac{1}{4}}{\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{1}{2}\)

Hence, The value of above expression is \(\frac{1}{2}\)

Calculation:

sin(A + B) = √3/2

⇒ sin(A + B )= sin60°

⇒  A + B = 60°      ….(i)

And, cos(A - B) = √3/2

⇒ cos(A - B) = cos30°

⇒  A – B = 30°      ….(ii)

Adding (i) and (ii)

We get, 2A = 90°

⇒  A = 45°

Putting in (i)

We get, 

⇒ 45° + B = 60°

⇒  B = 15°

∴ A and B are 45°and 15°

questions.question: Simplify: \(\left[ 1 - \sin^2 32^\circ + \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2 58^\circ} \right] \)
questions.questionHtml: Simplify: \(\left[ 1 - \sin^2 32^\circ + \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2 58^\circ} \right] \)
questions.solution:
1 - sin2 32° + (1)/(1 + tan2 58°) ⇒ (1)/(1 + tan2 58°) = cos2 58°

1 - sin2 32° + cos2 58° ⇒ cos 58° = sin 32° ⇒ 1 - sin2 32° + sin2 32° = 1

questions.question: If (48° + k) is an acute angle and sin(48° + k) = cos13°, what is the value of k(in °)?
questions.questionHtml: If (48° + k) is an acute angle and sin(48° + k) = cos13°, what is the value of k(in °)?
questions.solution:
sin(48º + k) = cos(13º)

⇒ 48º + k = 90º - 13º ⇒ k = 77º - 48º ⇒ k = 29º

questions.question: \(\frac{3sin58^{\circ}}{5cos32^{\circ}} + \frac{2cos62^{\circ}}{5sin28^{\circ}}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: \(\frac{3sin58^{\circ}}{5cos32^{\circ}} + \frac{2cos62^{\circ}}{5sin28^{\circ}}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
\(\frac{3sin58^{\circ}}{5cos32^{\circ}} + \frac{2cos62^{\circ}}{5sin28^{\circ}}\)

Formula used:

\(\sin (90^\circ - \theta) = \cos \theta \)

\(\cos (90^\circ - \theta) = \sin \theta\)

sin 58° = cos 32°, cos 62° = sin 28°

(3 sin 58°)/(5 cos 32°) + (2 cos 62°)/(5 sin 28°)

= (3 cos 32°)/(5 cos 32°) + (2 sin 28°)/(5 sin 28°)

= (3)/(5) + (2)/(5) = (3+2)/(5) = 1

questions.question: What is the value of \(\frac{5 \cos 62^{\circ}}{\sin 28^{\circ}}-\frac{2 \tan 34^{\circ}}{\cot 56^{\circ}}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: What is the value of \(\frac{5 \cos 62^{\circ}}{\sin 28^{\circ}}-\frac{2 \tan 34^{\circ}}{\cot 56^{\circ}}\)?
questions.solution:
\(\rm \frac{5 \cos 62^\circ}{\sin 28^\circ}-\frac{2 \tan 34^\circ}{cot\ 56^\circ}\)= \(\rm \frac{5 \sin (90-62)^\circ}{\sin 28^\circ}-\frac{2 \tan 34^\circ}{tan \ (90-56)^\circ}\)

⇒ \(\rm \frac{5 \sin 28^\circ}{\sin 28^\circ}-\frac{2 \tan 34^\circ}{tan \ 34^\circ}\) ⇒ 5 - 2 ⇒ 3
